question: Which units in the pinned core/alloc source inventory can the existing Rust frontend expose for later mechanism screening, and which remain unavailable?
population: All 338 archived Rust files, not similarity-selected
frontend: Existing rust-syntax-probe syn-unit-probe/2 and check_syn_probe.parse; rebuild locked/offline with Rust1.95.0; do not repair source syntax or replace rejected files
extraction: Function/impl_fn/trait_fn with body; existing export_rust_baseline_corpus.extract validates ranges; retain all other unit counts and parse failures
identity: SHA256 of pinned commit, path, source digest, syntax index and byte range
screening_metadata: Direct doc/cfg counts, ancestor indices, physical package, body and signature ranges; not doc correctness, full inherited context, type resolution or cfg activation
limits: No automatic semantic labels or independent-test eligibility
stop: Complete all files once with per-file 30s parser bound, preserve failures; source review may select at most three mechanism families as development/preparation candidates with reasons, not held-out labels
